artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.medium: watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gifted at the request of members of the artist's family
artworks.description: The image shows a street view from an elevated point, looking down a gentle slope between two large buildings. The horizon is low in the composition with hills and faded structures in the distance. The architectural elements along the street include a domed building with windows on the left and a receding colonnade. On the right, a building with an awning is depicted in muted tones. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, creating movement and airiness in a watercolor technique. The color palette is soft and subdued, with earthy tones like browns and beiges, greens, and blues. Small, dark figures are seen close by, hinting at activity.

artworks.title: Generalife
artworks.medium: watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gifted at the request of members of the artist's family
artworks.description: The image shows stone steps with terracotta pots, plants, red flowers at the bottom left. Two white pedestals with statuarial busts are on the right. A large column is on the left. Dense greenery, a clear sky with fluffy clouds are in the background. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid. The color palette includes soft earth tones, vibrant greens, deep blues, and bursts of red.

artworks.title: Granada
artworks.medium: watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gifted at the request of members of the artist's family
artworks.description: The image shows a garden with a sky visible in the background through an open space. An intricately painted urn is placed on a pillar above a garden wall. The painting technique features soft, fluid brushstrokes typical of watercolor, creating texture and movement in the foliage. The color palette includes vibrant shades of green, blue, and earthy tones contrasting with warmer hues of the wall and pillar. Dark greens of trees and plants contrast with the lighter sky tones. A rusty iron fence adds structure closer to the viewer, and the scene transitions into softer blue hues in the distance.

artworks.title: Tangier
artworks.medium: watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gifted at the request of members of the artist's family
artworks.description: The painting features an elevated viewpoint showing a hill or mound with colorful buildings in the distance. The horizon is positioned towards the upper third of the composition, partially obscured by the hill. A faded tower-like structure is visible at the top. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, using a watercolor technique with soft color transitions. The palette includes earthy tones like browns, ochres, and yellows, as well as muted pastels like blue and lavender. A brown wall or structure with small figures or birds is depicted in the foreground. The sky above is mostly blank with a hint of grey.

artworks.title: Studies for Christ Before Caiaphas
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white gouache on gray-green laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in various poses. It features sketches of individuals in different stances and activities, including a seated figure, a figure with a cloak, and others in dynamic poses with outstretched arms. The sketch is done in a classic style, likely with charcoal or graphite, providing strong contrasts and gentle shading to give depth and form to the figures. The style and depiction suggest studies or preparatory sketches for a larger work, possibly capturing movement and the human form in a timeless, classical manner.

artworks.title: Anna Maria van Schurman
artworks.artist: Cornelis van Dalen the Younger, after Cornelis Jonson van Ceulen
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a woman from the waist up, seated with her body facing forward. She has a serene expression, arched eyebrows, full lips, slightly wavy hair reaching her shoulders, and wears a large, flowing garment with voluminous sleeves and a gathered neckline. She holds a small object in her right hand. The frame features two cherubs at the bottom corners, different ornate elements in their hands. In the background, there is a circular opening showing a classic architectural structure resembling a tower. The background also includes symbolic objects and classical motifs.

artworks.title: Jacques Stella
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 19.7 × 16.1 cm (7 3/4 × 6 5/16 in.), trimmed inside platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a man in three-quarter view, with a long, narrow face, a mustache, and wavy, shoulder-length hair. He is wearing a dark garment with a wide collar and a ruffled inner shirt, holding a rolled piece of paper or a scroll in his right hand. The background has a textured pattern. An inscription is at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Charles-Antoine Coypel
artworks.artist: Nicolas Henri Tardieu, after Charles-Antoine Coypel
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the waist up, seated or leaning on a table. Their head is resting on one hand, supported by their elbow on the surface. They have curly medium-length hair emerging from a soft headpiece. Their facial expression is neutral, with slightly parted lips, and their eyes facing the viewer. The person is dressed in period-appropriate attire, holding a pen above a piece of paper. There is a cloth draped around their shoulder and a bust of another head on the table. The backdrop consists of bookshelves filled with books, framed by an oval structure covered partially by a curtain.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait, Laughing (Le rieur)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man's upper body, shown in a three-quarter view. The man is slightly turned to the side, with his face looking towards the viewer. He has distinct facial features, including a pronounced nose and a slight smile. His hair is styled in a typical 18th-century fashion, tied back with a ribbon. He is wearing a coat that appears to be formal attire of the time, possibly with a high collar. The image is monochrome, highlighting the details of the engraving. The background has lined shading, directing focus to the man. An artist's inscription is visible below the portrait, providing creator and publication details.

artworks.title: Bernard Picart
artworks.medium: mezzotint and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays an upper torso portrait of a person seated at a desk. The individual is facing forward with their body slightly turned to the right. They have a full head of curly hair that cascades down onto their shoulders, framing their face. They have a neutral expression. They are wearing a richly detailed, patterned robe over a light-colored shirt with ruffled cuffs at the wrists. One elbow is resting on the desk while the other hand holds a drawing or print. Various artistic instruments are laid out on the desk. In the background, there is a library shelf filled with large books, some with visible titles, and a draped curtain to the right.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait of the Artist's Father in a Forest
artworks.artist: Martin Elias Ridinger, after Johann Elias Ridinger
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in a natural setting on a rustic chair. The person has one leg extended and the other bent, holding a long cane with one hand. They have a rounded face and long hair, possibly worn under a cap. They are dressed in a loose-fitting garment with a sash. The background is a lush woodland scene with trees and foliage. In front of the person is an easel with a painting of a deer in a forest, and on the ground beside them is a drawing pad. The background includes trees and foliage, with one tree arching over the scene.

artworks.title: Élisabeth Louise Vigée Le Brun
artworks.artist: Johann Gotthard Müller, after Élisabeth Louise Vigée Le Brun
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a woman within an oval frame. She holds an artist's palette and paintbrushes in her left hand. She has an elongated face, expressive eyes, and curly hair, partially covered by a hat. She wears an elegant gown with flowing sleeves and ornate earrings. Surrounding her are rolled papers and a bouquet of flowers. The background is a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait wih Pipe
artworks.medium: drypoint [proof] on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a detailed portrait drawing showing the upper part of a man's body. The man is positioned with his body slightly turned to the side, while his face is directed towards the viewer. His facial features include deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full beard and mustache. His hair is curly and appears voluminous under a cap or hat. He is wearing a jacket over a high-collared garment and is holding a pipe with his lips, which extends outward to the right. The background is plain and uncluttered.

artworks.title: Sur la falaise [Self-Portrait]
artworks.medium: drypoint and roulette printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virgina and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image features a man shown from the waist up, seated in a relaxed position. His head is slightly turned to the left side of the frame, with his gaze directed into the distance. He has a thick, curly beard and mustache, with curly hair peeking out from beneath his hat. The man is wearing a brimmed hat and is clad in a suit coat over a collared shirt, which appears to be fastened by a bow tie. He holds a set of brushes in one hand along with what seems to be a canvas or sketchpad. The background depicts a serene, slightly blurred seascape with a wooden fence running horizontally along the coast. The image is rendered in monochromatic tones.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint (before reduction of the copper plate)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virgina and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting at a desk with various objects like bottles, a palette, and brushes in front of him. He wears a knitted cap and a dark robe. He is holding a writing instrument over a piece of paper, with a framed picture partially visible in the background.

artworks.title: The Anchorite
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint [proof before first edition of 1875] with selective wiping on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon line emphasizing the sky filled with swirling clouds depicted through expressive brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of grey creating contrast. In the foreground, there is a figure sitting with a pot-like object nearby, blending into the earth tones. A gnarled tree stands behind the figure. In the distance, a stretch of land leads to the horizon.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures with detailed body compositions. The central figure is seated, holding an infant, surrounded by other individuals. The faces show expressive features, though limited by a monochromatic palette. The central figure wears a head covering and draped garments. Surrounding figures display different hairstyles and head coverings. The infant is naked and cradled. The background features architectural elements like columns and arches intertwined with leafy vines. An angelic figure hovers above, with wings spread. The scene blends classical architecture with natural elements.

artworks.title: Windsor Terrass looking Westward
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of Windsor Terrace facing westward. A large building, possibly part of Windsor Castle, is on the left side with turrets and windows. In the middle ground, there are hills and a distant landscape against a soft sky. The painting is detailed with precise brushwork, emphasizing architectural features and trees. The color scheme consists of brown sepia tones. People in period clothing, some with children and pets, are in the foreground, adding activity. In the background, the landscape extends towards the horizon, revealing the surrounding countryside.

artworks.title: Manerbawr Castle from the Inward Court
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint with roulette and mezzotint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sepia-toned illustration of Manerbawr Castle from a frontal point of view. The castle's walls are detailed with aged brickwork, arched windows, and battlements. Several figures are engaged in work near the castle, including one leading a horse-drawn carriage and others handling tools. The ruins of the castle walls continue into the distance, partially covered by vegetation. The color palette is entirely shades of brown, and the clouds above are lightly sketched.

artworks.title: Benton Castle, Looking down the Reach to Milford Haven
artworks.medium: Etching and aquatint with roulette and mezzotint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with water, a sailboat, and Benton Castle in the distance. There are clouds in the sky. The brushwork is neat, different elements are clearly separated, and the color palette is dominated by sepia and earthy tones with lighter highlights.

artworks.title: Caernarvon Castle (Night)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows Caernarvon Castle from a distance, with a body of water in the foreground. The castle dominates the right side of the scene, with buildings and towers meeting the sky at the horizon just above the water level. The brushstrokes are meticulous, capturing architectural details and light and shadow. The color palette is mainly sepia, giving the image an aged feel. A figure with a horse is near the water's edge, while sailboats can be seen in the distance. Buildings with illuminated windows are visible, reflecting on the water. The sky is partly cloudy, with the moon shining through breaks in the clouds, creating a peaceful night setting.

artworks.title: Euterpe (Personification of Music)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash, heightened with white gouache, on gray-green laid paper squared in black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The person in the image is depicted in a dynamic stance, balancing on one leg while holding a cylindrical object with an ornate base. The person's head is tilted back, and the facial features include a slightly parted mouth and curly hair framing the face. The clothing is elaborate and flowing, with layered sleeves, and the figure stands within an abstract frame in front of a plain background.

artworks.title: Scene of Witchcraft
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and brown washes and black chalk on laid paper

artworks.title: Contending Group after Nature [A Lion Fighting a Tiger and a Leopard]
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with gray and brown wash over graphite on laid paper, mounted
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Connie Simmons and James D. Krugman
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lion, tiger, and leopard in a struggle. Below the three entangled cats, the body of a sheep lays on the ground. The tiger is on top of the sheep, lying on its back, its mouth open to reveal sharp teeth. The lion is on top of the tiger, biting into its neck, its long mane visible. The leopard is crouched on the right, also appearing trapped under the lion, moving away from the other two with its mouth open in a snarl. The background contains pale lines and leaf shapes that hint at an outdoor setting.
